paper.title: RoCo: Role-Based LLMs Collaboration for Automatic Heuristic Design
paper.source_path: C:/Users/风与纸片人/Desktop/RoCo Role-Based LLMs Collaboration for Automatic Heuristic Design.pdf

blocks.original_text: Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD) has gained traction...
blocks.translation: 自动启发式设计逐渐成为求解组合优化问题的重要途径。

blocks.original_text: RoCo coordinates four specialized LLM-guided agents...
blocks.translation: RoCo 协调探索者、利用者、批评者和集成者。

blocks.original_text: These agents interact in a structured multi-round process...
blocks.translation: 四类智能体执行结构化多轮反馈、精炼和精英变异。

blocks.original_text: A combinatorial optimization problem is formulated as P=(I_P,S_P,f)...
blocks.translation: COP 由实例集、可行解集和目标函数构成，AHD 搜索高质量启发式。

blocks.original_text: RoCo operates as a plug-in system integrated within EoH...
blocks.translation: RoCo 作为插件嵌入 EoH，合并标准候选、协作输出和记忆变异。

blocks.original_text: The four main roles are defined by role-specific policies...
blocks.translation: 四类角色分别负责探索、局部改进、批评和融合。

blocks.original_text: After T rounds, short-term reflections are synthesized...
blocks.translation: 短期反思结合目标变化被压缩为长期角色记忆。

blocks.original_text: The pseudocode samples an elite pair...
blocks.translation: 伪代码执行精英对采样、多轮协作、长期反思、记忆变异和 Top-N 保留。

blocks.original_text: The experiments cover TSP, CVRP, OP, MKP, and offline BPP...
blocks.translation: 实验覆盖五类 COP，并采用 GPT-4o-mini、3 轮协作和每代 400 次调用上限。

blocks.original_text: The paper’s empirical story is that role specialization...
blocks.translation: 经验性主张是角色专门化、多轮反思和精英记忆改善收敛与鲁棒性。

blocks.original_text: The long-term reflection, historical memory, role policies...
blocks.translation: 长期记忆和角色策略主要通过提示词描述，复现细节不充分。

blocks.original_text: The paper concludes that RoCo provides a role-based multi-agent paradigm...
blocks.translation: 结论提出角色化 LLM-AHD 范式，并把连续/混合整数优化列为未来方向。

blocks.original_text: RoCo’s natural abstraction is a population of executable heuristics...
blocks.translation: 迁移到昂贵黑盒优化时，应改为候选点、oracle 观测和 surrogate 数据集。

blocks.original_text: Explorer–exploiter collaboration balances long-term novelty...
blocks.translation: 在昂贵场景中，集成者应成为考虑预算和不确定性的 acquisition/资源分配器。

blocks.original_text: The appendix provides pseudocode, benchmark generation details...
blocks.translation: 附录给出伪代码、数据、参数、提示词和启发式代码示例。
